name: Iora
source:
He is a member of a certain ethnic group living in a remote area of ​​a small country under the rule of an empire.

After being spotted by Canaria's mother, he became Canaria's follower.

Purchasing supplies, preparing food and taking care of Canaria are all his jobs.

A being who understands Canaria's loneliness and stays by her side.

Originally, his nation did not have the culture of "word".

But since he became Canaria's follower, he learned to read and write under her advice, and now he enjoys reading all kinds of books.

Influenced by Canaria's tone and books, he can use some hard words.

His special trick is squirting.
